label: def:Wspace
title: Definition
body_md:
\label{def:Wspace}
    Given weights ${\bm{W}} \in \mathbb R^{p \times (d+1)}$, let 
    ${\bm{w}}_t = {\bm{W}}_{:,\,d+1}$, ${\bm{w}}_{{\bm{x}}_m} = {\bm{W}}_{:,\,m}$, and ${\bm{a}}_{1k} = {\bm{A}}_{1k,:}$ for $m, k \in \{1, \dots, d\}$. Define ${\bm{w}}_{\bm{x}} = \sum_{m=1}^d {\bm{w}}_{{\bm{x}}_m}$ and ${\bm{a}}_1 = \sum_{k=1}^d {\bm{a}}_{1k}$. 
    
    We can then define the following functions: \begin{inparaenum}[\bf (i)]
        \item $f_1({\bm{W}})={\bm{a}}_1\odot{\bm{w}}_t$, 
        \item $f_{2m}({\bm{W}})={\bm{a}}_{1}\odot{\bm{w}}_{{\bm{x}}_m}$,
        \item $f_3({\bm{W}})={\bm{a}}_2\odot{\bm{w}}_{\bm{x}}$,
        \item $f_4({\bm{W}})=\sum_{m=1}^d{\bm{a}}_1\odot{\bm{w}}_{{\bm{x}}_m}\odot{\bm{w}}_{{\bm{x}}_m}$, and
        \item $f_5({\bm{W}})=\sum_{m=1}^d{\bm{a}}_{1m}\odot{\bm{w}}_{{\bm{x}}_m}$,
    \end{inparaenum}
    where ${\bm{a}}_{1m}$, ${\bm{a}}_1$, ${\bm{a}}_2$, ${\bm{w}}_{{\bm{x}}_m}$, ${\bm{w}}_t$, and ${\bm{w}}_{{\bm{x}}}$ are as given above.
                                        
    Now, given constants $B_{f_i}$ for $i \in [5]$ by the following constraints are defined,
    \begin{gather}\label{eq:fbounds}
        \sum_{q=1}^p \abs{f_s({\bm{W}})_q} \leq B_{f_s} \textrm{ for $s \in \{1,3,4,5\}$}\ ; \qquad
        \sum_{m=1}^d\sum_{q_1,q_2 = 1}^p \abs{f_{2m}({\bm{W}})_{q_1}} \abs{a_{1m,q_2}} \leq B_{f_2},
    \end{gather}
    where $f_1$, $f_{2m}$, $f_3$, $f_4$ and $f_5$ are the functions defined above.
                                      
    Corresponding to the above, we define the class of weights ${\mathcal{C}}$ as,
    \begin{align*}
        {\mathcal{C}} \coloneq \big\{{\bm{W}} \in \mathbb R^{p \times (d+1)}\ \big| {\bm{W}} \text{ satisfies the bounds given in Equation \ref{eq:fbounds}} \big\}.
    \end{align*}
    
    We further define $\textrm{RS}({\mathcal{C}})$ as the set of possible row vectors from the elements of ${\mathcal{C}}$.
head: environment
name: {\bf Class of Weights for $(d+1)$-Navier-Stokes}

label: thm:NSRad
title: Theorem
body_md:
\label{thm:NSRad}
    Let ${\mathcal{N}}_{{\bm{w}}}$ be a neural network as in Definition~\ref{def:nn}, with weights ${\bm{W}} \in {\mathcal{C}}$, where the class of weights ${\mathcal{C}}$ is defined in Definition~\ref{def:Wspace}. We make the following assumptions about the activation function $\sigma(x)$:
    \begin{inparaenum}[(i)]
    \item $\sigma(x)$ is twice differentiable,
    \item $\sigma(x)$, $\sigma'(x)$, and $\sigma''(x)$ are Lipschitz continuous with constants $L_{\sigma}$, $L_{\sigma'}$, and $L_{\sigma''}$, respectively, and
    \item $\sigma(x)$ and $\sigma'(x)$ are bounded by constants $B_{\sigma}$ and $B_{\sigma'}$, respectively.
    \end{inparaenum}
    Let the two components of the loss function, $\ell_{res}$ and $\ell_0$, be defined as in Definition~\ref{def:lossclass}. From Definition~\ref{def:collocation}, we recall the constants $C_{\bm{z}}$ and $C_{{\bm{z}}_0}$, which characterize the distributions of the collocation points in the interior and on the initial-condition boundaries, respectively. We can then bound the generalization error of the empirical loss by
    \begin{align}
        &\mathbb{E}_{\substack{({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri}) \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r] \\ {\bm{x}}_{0j} \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]}} \Bigg[\sup_{{\bm{W}} \in {\mathcal{C}}} \biggl( \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}({\mathcal{N}}_{\bm{w}},({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) + \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}({\mathcal{N}}_{\bm{w}},{\bm{x}}_{0j})\nonumber\\ 
        &\hspace{15.00em}- \left( \mathbb{E}_{({\bm{x}}_r,t_r) \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1}[\ell_{res}({\mathcal{N}}_{{\bm{w}}},({\bm{x}}_{r},t_{r}))] + \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_0 \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2}[\ell_{0}({\mathcal{N}}_{{\bm{w}}},{\bm{x}}_{0})] \right) \biggr)\Bigg] \nonumber\\
        &\hspace{1.00em}\leq \frac{2 \delta (B_{{\bm{w}}} C_{\bm{z}} C_1 + C_2)}{\sqrt{N_r}} + \frac{4 \lambda_1 \delta B_{\bm{a}} (B_{{\bm{w}}} C_{{\bm{z}}_0} L_\sigma + \abs{c_0})}{\sqrt{N_0}},
    \end{align}
    
    here, $C_1 \coloneqq 2B_{f_1}L_{\sigma'}+4B_{f_2}(B_\sigma L_{\sigma'}+B_{\sigma'}L_\sigma)+2B_{f_3}L_{\sigma'}+2\nu B_{f_4} L_{\sigma''}+2 \lambda_0 B_{f_5}L_{\sigma'}$ and $C_2 \coloneqq  B_{f_1}\abs{c_1} + B_{f_2}(2B_{\sigma'}\abs{c_0} + \abs{c_0 c_1}) + B_{f_3}\abs{c_1} + \nu B_{f_4}\abs{c_2} + \lambda_0 B_{f_5}\abs{c_1}$, where $B_{f_s}$ for $s \in [5]$ are as defined in Definition~\ref{def:Wspace}, $c_0 = \sigma(0)$, $c_1 = \sigma'(0)$, $c_2 = \sigma''(0)$, and $\delta$ is the Lipschitz constant of the loss function $\ell_{H,\delta}$ as in Definition~\ref{def:huber}. We also assume that there exist constants $B_{{\bm{w}}}$ and $B_{\bm{a}}$ such that $\norm{{\bm{w}}_q}_2 \leq B_{{\bm{w}}}, \forall q \in [p]$, where ${\bm{w}}_q = {\bm{W}}_{q,:}$, and $\sum_{q=1}^p \abs{({\bm{a}}_1)_q} \leq B_{\bm{a}}$, for ${\bm{a}}_1$ is as in Definition~\ref{def:nn}.

body_md:
\begin{align*}
        &\sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) + \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) - \left( \mathbb{E}_{({\bm{x}}_r,{\bm{t}}_r) \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1}[\ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{r},{\bm{t}}_{r}))] + \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_0 \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2}[\ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0})] \right) \right)\\
        &= \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) + 
        \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) - \left( \mathbb{E}_{({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ti}') \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r]}\left[\frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ri}'))\right] \right.\right. \\
        &\hspace{26.0em} + \left.\left. \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_{0j}' \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]}\left[\frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}')\right] \right) \right)\\
        &= \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \mathbb{E}_{({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ti}') \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r]} \left[\frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) - \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ri}')) \right] \right. \\
        &\hspace{17.0em} \left. + \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_{0j}' \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]} \left[ \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) - \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}')\right] \right)\\
        &\leq \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \mathbb{E}_{({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ti}') \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r]} \left[ \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) - \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ri}')) \right] \right) \\
        &\hspace{17.0em} + \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_{0j}' \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]} \left[\frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) - \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}')\right] \right)\\
        &\leq \mathbb{E}_{({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ti}') \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r]} \left[ \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left(\frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) - \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ri}'))\right) \right] \\
        &\hspace{17.0em} + \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_{0j}' \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]} \left[ \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) - \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}') \right)\right]
    \end{align*}
    Now taking the expectation over $({\bm{x}}_{ri}, t_{ri})$ and $x_{0i}$ on both sides we get
    \begin{align*}
        &\mathbb{E}_{\substack{({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri}) \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r] \\ {\bm{x}}_{0j} \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]}} \left[\sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) + \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) - \left( \mathbb{E}_{(x_r,t_r) \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1}[\ell_{res}(h,(x_{r},t_{r}))] + \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_0 \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2}[\ell_{0}(h,x_{0})] \right) \right)\right]\\
        &\leq \mathbb{E}_{({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri}) \sim D_1 \forall i \in [N_r]}\left[ \mathbb{E}_{({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ti}') \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r]} \left[ \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left(\frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} (\ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) - \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ri}')))\right) \right] \right]\\
        &\hspace{15.0em} + \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_{0j} \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]} \left[\mathbb{E}_{{\bm{x}}_{0j}' \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]} \left[ \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} (\ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) - \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}')) \right)\right]\right]\\
        &= \mathbb{E}_{\substack{({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri}) \sim D_1 \forall i \in [N_r] \\ ({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ti}') \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r]}}\left[ \mathbb{E}_{\epsilon_i\sim \{\pm 1\}} \left[ \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left(\frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \epsilon_i(\ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) - \ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ri}')))\right) \right] \right]\\
        &\hspace{15.0em} + \mathbb{E}_{\substack{{\bm{x}}_{0j} \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0] \\ {\bm{x}}_{0j}' \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]}} \left[\mathbb{E}_{\epsilon_j \sim \{\pm 1\}} \left[ \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \epsilon_j (\ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) - \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}')) \right)\right]\right]\\
        &\leq \mathbb{E}_{\substack{({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri}) \sim D_1 \forall i \in [N_r] \\ ({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ti}') \sim {\mathcal{D}}_1 \forall i \in [N_r]}}\left[ \mathbb{E}_{\epsilon_i\sim \{\pm 1\}} \left[ \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left(\frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} \epsilon_i\ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri},t_{ri})) \right) + \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_r} \sum_{i=i}^{N_r} - \epsilon_i\ell_{res}(h,({\bm{x}}_{ri}',t_{ri}')) \right) \right] \right]\\
        &\hspace{15.0em} + \mathbb{E}_{\substack{{\bm{x}}_{0j} \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0] \\ {\bm{x}}_{0j}' \sim {\mathcal{D}}_2 \forall j\in[N_0]}} \left[\mathbb{E}_{\epsilon_j \sim \{\pm 1\}} \left[ \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} \epsilon_j \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}) \right) + \sup_{h\in{\mathcal{H}}} \left( \frac{1}{N_0} \sum_{j=i}^{N_0} - \epsilon_j \ell_{0}(h,{\bm{x}}_{0j}') \right)\right]\right]\\
        &= 2{\mathcal{R}}_{res} ({\mathcal{H}}) + 2{\mathcal{R}}_{0} ({\mathcal{H}})
    \end{align*}
